artworks.title: My Dream
artworks.description: The image shows a historical waterfront scene with small boats on the water, larger sailing ships, elaborate architecture on the left, a statue on a column, spires and rooftops in the distance, and a cloudy sky. The style is detailed and fine-lined with a monochromatic color palette of sepia tones.

artworks.title: Edmond de Goncourt
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body, primarily focusing on their face. The individual is in a stationary, forward-facing position. The facial features include a mustache and bushy eyebrows. The hair is light in color and slightly wavy. The person is wearing a high-collared garment. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background is a plain, dark tone, creating contrast with the soft focus of the figure's features.

artworks.title: In the Dunes: Souvenir of The Hague  (Dans les dunes: Souvenir du bois de La Haye)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, trees, and structures under a vast sky. The horizon line is low, with hills and buildings along it. The artwork is detailed, with cross-hatched lines. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily grayscale. Closest to us are shadowy trees on the left side, depicted with dense lines, contrasting with the lighter sky and open landscape in the distance.

artworks.title: Environs of Rome (Environs de Rome)
artworks.description: This artwork depicts a view from within a shaded woodland. The horizon is positioned about one-third from the bottom of the image, marked by a distant silhouette of a castle or large building. Tall trees with dense foliage frame the view. The brushstrokes are finely detailed and cross-hatched, creating texture in the ground and sky. The color palette is a sepia tone, giving the image a classic atmosphere. Varied line density creates contrast and depth, drawing the eye towards the lightest part of the image at the horizon.

artworks.title: Souvenir of Tuscany (Souvenir de Toscane)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape captured from an elevated viewpoint showing uneven terrain and a distant structure. The horizon is low in the composition, emphasizing the expansive sky. A building and trees partially obscure the horizon. The brushwork is detailed with intricate linework, likely using etching or engraving techniques. Cross-hatching creates texture and shadow for the foliage and rocky ground. The scene is monochromatic, using browns and sepia tones for light and shadow, highlighting natural elements and a man-made structure in the distance.

artworks.title: Chère baronne, je vous félicite...
artworks.description: The drawing depicts two figures conversing in a swimming area. One figure is dressed in elaborate attire, including a large hat, while the other wears a dark bathing suit. Other figures are swimming in the water around them. The background features architectural elements hinting at an ornate building. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette with various shades of gray and black, using line work to define form and volume. The style is satirical and observational in nature.

artworks.title: L'Escompte d'un billet
artworks.description: Two individuals are depicted in the image. The person on the left is standing, gesturing towards a table. They have a side-parted hairstyle with chin-length hair and are wearing a long, dark coat over a high-collared shirt. The person at the table is older, with chin-length hair under a cap. They are dressed in a light, striped shirt with a scarf and are holding a piece of paper. There is a cylindrical container on the table. The background is plain with crosshatched shading, and there is an indistinct handwritten note at the top.

artworks.title: Maréchal Bugeaud
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man standing with his arms crossed. He has exaggerated facial features, a large head, deeply set eyes, bushy eyebrows, and curly hair. He is wearing formal attire and is surrounded by a sketch of indistinct figures in the background.

artworks.title: Oui je viens, dans son temple...
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration featuring two people shown from the waist up. On the left is a person in profile facing right, wearing a classical helmet with a crest, armor, and a visible section of cape or drapery. The person has curly hair peeking out from under the helmet. To the right is another person facing forward with long white hair and beard, sharp facial features, and dressed in flowing robes. The background is indistinct with some shading. Handwritten text at the bottom of the image provides context to the scene.

artworks.title: Saperlotte!... que je voudrais... que ma femme ait fini...
artworks.description: Two full-length figures are depicted in profile. On the right, a woman stands holding a piece of paper with one hand, the other resting across her chest. She has distinct facial features and neatly styled hair. She is wearing a long dress. Behind her to the left, a man is depicted in a bent stance, wearing a tall top hat and long coat over a patterned outfit with tight-fitting trousers. He appears to be holding something. The background shows a sketchy outdoor setting with rocks and sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Un Diner maigre
artworks.description: Two men are seated at a table. The man on the left has a receding hairline and a focused expression. He wears a dark jacket over a collared shirt and tie. The man on the right is reading a piece of paper and has thinning hair combed back. He wears a dark jacket as well. On the table are wine bottles, a carafe, glasses, and plates with food, including a loaf of bread. The background is a soft gradient.

artworks.title: Un Triomphe de botaniste
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up. The man in the foreground is leaning forward towards a small potted plant on a table. He has a receding hairline and sideburns and is dressed in a suit with a visible tie. The other man stands slightly behind him, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, glasses, a bow tie, and a collared shirt. Both men are depicted in black and white with cross-hatching for shadows. The background consists of abstract lines and shading, resembling a textured wall or interior setting.

artworks.title: Ah!... quelle singulière éducation vous donnez a votre fille?...
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures: two women sitting across from each other and a young girl seated on the floor. The woman on the left is shown from the back at a three-quarter view, sitting on a chair with her body turned slightly to the side. She has a neat bun hairstyle and wears glasses, a light-colored skirt, and a dark shawl. The other woman sits behind a small table, facing the viewer with her head turned to look at the woman on the left. She has neat hair and wears a dark dress with her shoulders covered. The young girl sits on the floor, her head bowed, and is either reading or sewing. She has her hair gathered at the nape with a ribbon and wears a simple dress with long sleeves. In the background, there is a framed picture on the wall above a decorative vase placed on a molding. The setting is an interior space with curtains to the right, suggesting a domestic and slightly formal environment.

artworks.title: Abonnés recevant leur journal...
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals reading newspapers in different positions. Two standing men are reading a newspaper titled "La Presse," a woman is reclined on a patterned sofa using a handheld device to read "Les Debats," and a man is lying on the floor examining a newspaper. The background consists of ashen walls and a large ornate picture frame.

artworks.title: Une Heureuse trouvaille
artworks.description: There are two men in the image. One, on the left, is seen from the side, angled towards the other man on the right who is mostly seen from the back and side. The man on the left has a prominent nose and expressive eyes, with his hair styled back. He is wearing a dark jacket and a high-collar outfit typical of the 19th century. The man on the right is wearing a tall hat with a bobble and an elaborate patterned robe. The man on the left's hand is raised. The background is monochromatic with soft cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Le Jour de l'an
artworks.description: The image shows two people, a woman and a man, from the waist up engaged in a close interaction. The woman is on the left, standing with her body slightly turned away but her face looking toward the man. She has a round face with distinct features, including a prominent nose, and long, dark, wavy hair. She is wearing a dress with a patterned texture and holds a rectangular object close to her chest. The man is on the right, leaning towards the woman. He has a receding hairline, neatly combed hair, sharp facial features, and is wearing a high-collared shirt with a tie beneath a well-fitted jacket. The background consists of crosshatched shading.

artworks.title: Un Monsieur qu'on rajeunit trop
artworks.description: The image features two individuals in an interior setting. A man is seated in a chair facing to his left, with a frontal reflection shown in an oval mirror. He has short, light-colored hair and wears a draped covering. Beside him, a woman leans forward slightly as she examines or works on his hair. She has dark hair styled in a bun and wears a textured dress. The background is softly shaded, focusing attention on the pair and the mirror, which reveals details of the man's face. The setting contains no additional objects.

artworks.title: La Visite a la nourrice
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals. In the foreground, a man is leaning forward with his hands placed on the shoulders of an older woman. She has a round face with prominent facial features and wears a headscarf. Her clothing consists of a simple dress, and she is holding a baby. The baby is small, clad in a striped outfit with a matching hat, and is positioned to rest on the woman's shoulder with its face turned towards the viewer. The man, seen from the side, has short hair with a receding hairline and sideburns. He wears a suit jacket with a high collar. In the background, there are sparse details suggesting a room setting, with a hat hanging on the wall visible.

artworks.title: Pour lors... nous... sommes dans le pétrin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man examining a basket of bread. The image shows an individual in simple attire closely observing a basket filled with long loaves of bread. The focus is on the interaction between the individual and the bread. In the background, there is an ornamental frame displaying text that reads "ORDONNANCE CONCERNANT LE POID DU PAIN." On the left side, there is a table with scales. The drawing employs cross-hatching and shading techniques to add depth and texture to the scene, with strong contrasts between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Ah! Saperlotte, je crois que nous sommes pincés!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a vineyard scene with two figures set among grapevines. There is a well-dressed figure with an exaggerated posture standing on a path, holding a top hat and gesturing dramatically towards another figure partially obscured by grapevines. The second figure appears to be wearing simpler clothing and seems to blend into the foliage. The grape leaves and bunches dominate the middle of the image, with a background sketched in bands of light and shadow. The entire scene is rendered in fine lines and shadings, conveying texture in the clothing of the figures and grapevines. The artwork captures a moment of interaction or discovery in the vineyard setting with a sense of drama and contrast between the characters.

artworks.title: Ainsi donc, mon ami, a vingt-deux ans...
artworks.description: The image shows three men seated closely together. They are all visible from the waist up. The man in the middle is upright and wears a dark suit and tall hat. He has a mustache and is gesturing with his hands while looking at the man on his right. The man on the left is slightly hunched, looking towards the man in the middle. He wears a shirt and cap with short, untidy hair. The man on the right is also hunched, dressed similarly to the man on the left, and appears to be looking at his wrist or an object in his hand. They are seated outdoors with large stone blocks and bricks behind them, with building outlines and visible windows in the background.

artworks.title: Je pars plus amoureux que... jamais...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the upper bodies up. One person is facing the other, with one hand on their chest. They have curly, short hair and distinct facial features. The other person is facing forward with straight, shoulder-length hair mostly covered by a veil. Their facial features are more subdued, with a calm expression. Both individuals wear different garments. The background consists of shaded areas, and there are handwritten words underneath the figures.

artworks.title: Ph. Auguste Demesmay
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a person sitting on a rock in profile. The person is writing in a book with a quill pen. They have exaggerated facial features, including a prominent forehead and chin. The person has tousled hair and is wearing a dark, long-sleeved shirt or jacket with patterned trousers. Next to them is the outline of a cow in the background.

artworks.title: Et dire que voila trois... prévenu que je n'ai pas pu faire condamner!...
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing in a room. On the right, a man stands with his arms crossed, looking stern. He has greying hair and wears a dark coat, trousers, and light-colored shirt. Next to him, a woman leans slightly towards him. She has neatly styled hair, wears a long dress with puffed sleeves, and her hands are lightly clasped. In the background, there is a framed portrait of an elderly person wearing spectacles and holding a closed book.
